four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: MISLEADING for this hypothesis -- goal_proximity is the latent proximity of current z_world to the persisted z_goal; it saturates near-ceiling in BOTH arms (FIELD_ONLY ~0.981, FIELD+BANK ~0.989; margin needed 0.01, observed deltas +0.008 / -0.0008). targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-651 FAIL is NON-CONTRIBUTORY (measurement / test-design defect), NOT a weakening of ARC-060. The discrete ghost-goal bank genuinely engaged (C1 met 3/3 seeds; 130-146 ghost candidates admitted; goal_active_frac=1.0), but the recovery margin was met on 0/3 seeds because the FIELD_ONLY NEGATIVE CONTROL never exhibited the premature abandonment ARC-060 predicts: Phase-C goal-proximity stayed near-ceiling in BOTH arms (FIELD_ONLY ~0.981, FIELD+BANK ~0.989; seed 42 FIELD_ONLY early 0.990 -> late 0.972). With the field-alone agent never losing the goal, the bank's rescue advantage has nothing to act on -- the discriminating condition (local-gradient collapse + abandonment) was never created. The latent goal_proximity-to-persisted-z_goal metric also saturates and does not read behavioural abandonment/re-approach. Re-queue as V3-EXQ-651a with (a) a Phase-B invalidation strong enough to force FIELD_ONLY drift (e.g. physically displace the agent far from the goal cell, or harden the invalidation), (b) a NON-DEGENERACY GATE requiring the FIELD_ONLY arm to show abandonment (late << early goal-proximity, or behavioural drop in re-approach) BEFORE the bank comparison is scored, and (c) a behavioural re-approach readout alongside the latent metric. pending_retest_after_substrate (test-design redesign).

learning_extracted: An OFF-vs-ON recovery test is only interpretable if the OFF (negative-control) arm first exhibits the failure mode the ON arm is meant to rescue -- 651 had no such gate, so a saturated negative control produced a spurious 0/3.

Latent goal_proximity-to-persisted-z_goal saturates near-ceiling and cannot discriminate abandonment from persistence in a small grid; ARC-060's prediction needs a behavioural abandonment/re-approach readout.
